# Service Menu Execution for The Forge

• **Audit what you're actually selling right now** — Have each coach list every service/package they've ever sold or discussed. You'll find inconsistencies (different prices, inclusions, messaging). This is your raw material. Takes 2 hours max with a quick team call.

• **Price anchoring move** — Start with your highest-value offering (likely 1-on-1 coaching). Lock that price first, then work backwards. Your group classes and memberships should feel cheaper *relative to that anchor*, making them obvious value plays. Test pricing on 5-10 existing members before finalizing.

• **Create two separate documents** (not one confusing master list):
  - **Coach version**: What each service entails, time required, any prep/follow-up, how to upsell/cross-sell naturally
  - **Member version**: Clean, benefit-focused (not feature-dumping). Include "this is for you if..." language for each tier

• **Make it a sales tool, not decoration** — Your coaches should be able to reference it mid-conversation. Laminate cards or pin it in the coaching area. If coaches aren't naturally referencing it within 2 weeks, you'll know it's missing something they actually need.

• **Lock it for 90 days minimum** — Changing prices/offerings constantly erodes trust. Commit to the menu, track what sells, *then* iterate. This discipline matters more than perfection now.
